title: Neon Horizon Cruise
summary: A dreamy synthwave track capturing the solitary euphoria of driving through a glowing, rain-slicked metropolis at midnight.
lyrics:
[Verse]
Streetlights bleed into the wet asphalt
Shadows dance as I pass them by
The engine hums a steady heartbeat
Underneath the endless sky
Reflections swirl in neon hues
Painting stories on the glass
I leave the world behind my rearview
Watching memories fade to black

[Chorus]
Driving through the neon horizon
Chasing stars that never fade
In this electric dream of mine
No time has passed or stayed
Just you and me and the city lights
Gliding through the midnight air
Lost in the glow of tomorrow
With nowhere left to go but there

[Bridge]
The radar blips in silence now
The speedometer spins around
We are ghosts in chrome and light
Floating free without a sound

[Chorus]
Driving through the neon horizon
Chasing stars that never fade
In this electric dream of mine
No time has passed or stayed
Just you and me and the city lights
Gliding through the midnight air
Lost in the glow of tomorrow
With nowhere left to go but there

cover_prompt: A retro-futuristic perspective from inside a classic sports car looking out onto a rain-slicked highway in a cyberpunk city at night. The dashboard glows with soft orange and purple analog dials. Outside, towering skyscrapers are bathed in vibrant cyan and magenta neon signs, reflecting off the wet pavement and the windshield. Mist rolls along the street level. The art style is painterly digital art with a heavy emphasis on bokeh effects from distant city lights. Color palette features deep indigo, electric blue, hot pink, and warm amber. No text or logos., square album cover art, no text, no lettering
theme: driving through a neon city at midnight
